reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Added the `app.kubernetes.io/name`, `app.kubernetes.io/instance`, `app.kubernetes.io/part-of`, `app.kubernetes.io/version`, `app.kubernetes.io/managed-by`, and…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Istio resources now include standardized Kubernetes recommended labels; label selectors, filters, and monitoring rules that depend on these labels being absent or different may be affected.

proposed.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds the Kubernetes recommended labels app.kubernetes.io/name, app.kubernetes.io/instance, app.kubernetes.io/part-of, app.kubernetes.io/version, app.kubernetes.io/managed-by, and helm.sh/chart to almost all resources.
